notes: Six strata (1st-8th c. CE). Stratum VI: upper part of the Early Roman drainage channel under the Stepped Street (known from Reich and Shukron 2011) and the street's makeup, sealed by a 70 CE destruction. Stratum IV (mid-6th c.): Byzantine paved street, drainage channels 225, 226, 229, 298 and vaulted Cistern 240. Channel 255 Stratum IV or II. Street pavements not eligible.
